### Description of PR
In Dual ToR ensure the mux is configured correctly before running the RADV test cases

Summary:
Fixes: [https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/8108](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/8108)

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] Test case(improvement)


### Back port request
- [ ] 201911

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Fix RADV test failure seen on Dual ToR:- [https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/8108](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/8108)

#### How did you do it?
Configure and verify the MUX status before each RADV test case runs

#### How did you verify/test it?

Run RADV test successfully on Dual ToR and Single ToR testbeds
